narrative_blocks: We, Alex Morgan and Taylor Jordan Reed, solemnly declare that we have cohabited in a continuous conjugal relationship at 742 Evergreen Terrace, Toronto, ON, Canada since May 1, 2022.

We share full joint financial responsibility, including a joint chequing account with Royal Bank of Canada, joint tenancy on our primary residence lease, mutual designation as primary beneficiaries on life insurance policies, and joint utility service obligations.
Solemnly declared before Sarah Jenkins, Notary Public and Commissioner for Taking Affidavits in the Province of Ontario, at the City of Toronto, this 15th day of June, 2024.

narrative_blocks: We, Liam Ethan Bennett and Sophia Marie Chen, declare that we have cohabited in a conjugal relationship at 1088 Burrard Street, Vancouver, BC since January 10, 2022.
This document was submitted without being solemnized before a Commissioner for Oaths, Notary Public, or Justice of the Peace. Section 4 remains unexecuted.
The statutory declaration lacks required attestation signatures, official notarization stamp, and solemnization date.

defect_spec.description: The IMM 5409 statutory declaration form lacks required solemnization signatures, notary/commissioner seal, official stamp, and execution date, rendering it legally invalid.

fields.imm5409_section_2_financial_arrangements: Joint lease and joint bank account
fields.express_entry_personal_history_address: 450 8th Avenue SW, Calgary, AB (Nov 2023 - May 2024: 6 months); Previous: 120 4th St, Calgary, AB (Alone)
fields.imm5409_deponent_signatures: Signed by Marcus Vance and Elena Rostova on 2024-05-10
fields.imm5409_commissioner_stamp: Official Notary Stamp - Province of Alberta

narrative_blocks: We, Marcus Aurelius Vance and Elena Rostova, declare that we have cohabited continuously at 450 8th Avenue SW, Calgary, AB from November 1, 2023 to May 10, 2024.
The period of continuous cohabitation documented is only 6 months, failing to meet the legal standard of 12 continuous months required under Canadian immigration regulations for common-law status.
Personal history and lease records confirm separate residential addresses prior to November 1, 2023.

defect_spec.description: The declaration and supporting evidence demonstrate only 6 months of continuous cohabitation prior to application submission, failing to meet the mandatory 12 consecutive months requirement.

mutation_details.gap_description: Insufficient cohabitation duration (6 months vs 12 required)

narrative_blocks: We, Ethan Gabriel Wright and Hannah Isobel Taylor, declare cohabitation at 1500 Main Street, Winnipeg, MB since June 1, 2021.

Significant discrepancies exist across official records: CRA tax returns for 2021-2023 report marital status as 'Single', Express Entry address history lists 789 Portage Ave, and provincial driver's licenses register 221 Baker Street until February 2024.
Contradictory official representations raise material concerns regarding potential misrepresentation or inaccurate declaration of marital and cohabitation status.

defect_spec.description: Material discrepancy between IMM 5409 claimed cohabitation dates/address and official government records (CRA tax filings reported as Single, Express Entry profile address mismatch, and delayed driver's license address update).
